[SWS_DM_01951] No session checks if no diagnostic session inside the diag- nostic access permission
⌈
If the Diagnostic Server instance is evaluating the diagnostic session to ex-
ecute the current diagnostic service and no DiagnosticAccessPermission or
DiagnosticAccessPermission.diagnosticSession references are configured,
the Diagnostic Service instance shall directly execute the diagnostic service
and skip the session checks.
⌋
